subject: Credit note for invoice INV-2526-01431
body:
Dear Delta Traders Private Limited team,

We have identified that invoice INV-2526-01431 dated 2025-09-25 was charged at 28 percent instead of the applicable 18 percent for HSN 8528. The excess tax amount is Rs 21,436. We will issue a credit note for this amount and provide a corrected invoice. Please update your records accordingly.
